limitations: TTFT/ITL/end-to-end curves are matched client-observed SSE timings; engine-resident timing fields are not cross-engine comparable.

hipEngine and llama.cpp backend-native decode timings have different ownership boundaries and are diagnostic only.
gfx1151 is UMA: whole-card GTT, not the 512 MiB visible-VRAM aperture, is the relevant external memory domain.
The external C>1 raw rates are retained only to show the blocked measurement; they are not performance claims.
